8f6-2lLDzgmRkKZR5hdSwA.zh: 法屬留旺島今年截至7/23累計報告221例確定病例,其中1例死亡。疫情於3月達高峰(71例)後,隨乾季來臨逐步下降,7月僅報告8例,淡水休閒活動及農業工作為主要暴露風險。今年65% 病例需住院治療,可能與延遲就醫或感染毒力較高之血清群有關。該島歷來以Icterohaemorrhagiae血清群為主要流行菌株,該血清群與較嚴重之臨床表現相關,可能引發韋氏病(Weil disease)。 印度喀拉拉州受雨季影響,疫情大幅上升,今年截至7/31累計報告1,394例確定病例及63例死亡,7月即新增415例確定病例及30例死亡,疫情已擴及至少10個地區,呈全州性傳播趨勢。死亡個案以40至69歲勞工及農業工作者為主,該病死亡數占該州傳染病死亡總數52%。鑑於8月為流行高峰期,且致死率已由4.2%升至6%,當局持續推廣以去氧羥四環素(doxycycline)進行預防性投藥,以抑制疫情。
8f6-2lLDzgmRkKZR5hdSwA.en: Réunion has reported 221 confirmed leptospirosis cases this year as of 23 July, including 1 death. After peaking in March (71 cases), cases declined with the arrival of the dry season, with only 8 cases reported in July. The main exposure risks are recreational freshwater activities and agricultural work. This year, 65% of cases required hospitalization, which may be related to delayed care-seeking or to more virulent infecting serogroups. The island has historically been dominated by the Icterohaemorrhagiae serogroup, which is associated with more severe clinical presentations and can cause Weil disease. In India, Kerala State has seen a sharp rise in cases during the monsoon season. As of 31 July this year, 1,394 confirmed cases and 63 deaths have been reported cumulatively, with 415 confirmed cases and 30 deaths added in July alone. The outbreak has spread to at least 10 areas, showing a statewide transmission trend. Deaths have mainly occurred among workers and agricultural workers aged 40 to 69 years, and leptospirosis accounts for 52% of the state's total infectious disease deaths. As August is the peak season and the case fatality ratio has risen from 4.2% to 6%, authorities continue to promote doxycycline chemoprophylaxis to curb the outbreak.

Cs9V0p1HLvpqryc-DxhjAQ.zh: 馬達加斯加疫情自2025年12月中旬爆發以來急遽升溫,截至6/7 累計報告3,241例病例,其中1,976例確定病例及7例死亡。最近1 例死亡病例為39歲女性,並同時感染HIV,突顯免疫低下族群感染第I分支Ib子分支(Ib型)之重症風險。另葛摩及模里西斯分別於今年1月與4月報告來自馬國的境外移入病例。 留旺自2026年1月23日報告首例以來,累計15例確定病例(10例境外移入,5例本土)。近兩週新增3例(1例自馬達加斯加境外移入、2例本土),目前尚未確認該病毒分支,推估應為Ib型。當局已於2/9針對免疫低下者、MSM族群、性工作者及赴馬國旅客,全面推動兩劑型JYNNEOS疫苗接種計畫。 模里西斯於6/4確診今年首例本土病例,個案近期無旅遊史,為在當地居住的64歲瑞士籍男性。該國今年累計報告3例(2例境外移入、1例本土)。
Cs9V0p1HLvpqryc-DxhjAQ.en: Madagascar's outbreak has escalated sharply since it began in mid-December 2025. As of 7 June, 3,241 cases had been reported cumulatively, including 1,976 confirmed cases and 7 deaths. The most recent death was a 39-year-old woman co-infected with HIV, highlighting the risk of severe disease among immunocompromised people infected with clade Ib (subclade Ib). Comoros and Mauritius reported imported cases from Madagascar in January and April this year, respectively. Réunion has reported 15 cumulative confirmed cases since its first case on 23 January 2026 (10 imported, 5 local). It has recorded three new cases in the past two weeks (one imported from Madagascar, two local). The virus subclade has not yet been confirmed but is presumed to be Ib. On 9 February, a two-dose JYNNEOS vaccination programme was launched for immunocompromised people, MSM, sex workers and travellers to Madagascar. Mauritius confirmed its first local case this year on 4 June, in a 64-year-old Swiss man living locally with no recent travel history. The country has reported three cases this year (two imported, one local).

SydaT1vhYVwa3HYYx6oXHA.zh: 每月更新:  全球自2022年截至今(2026)年1/31累計144國/地區報告17萬9千餘例確診病例,其中,至少483例死亡。 今年1月共計50國家/地區報告1,334 例新增確診病例,其中3例死亡,66%來自非洲地區,相較去年12月,歐洲區病例數上升,其餘地區疫情下降。全球各區疫情皆呈下降趨勢,葛摩及法屬留旺島通報首例 Ib 型病例。 非洲地區近6週(2026/1/5-2/15)共計20國通報1,142例確診病例,其中4例死亡,以剛果民主共和國、幾內亞、馬達加斯加、賴比瑞亞及迦納為高;非洲以外地區,法國、葡萄牙及西班牙持續出現Ib型社區傳播。 WHO 於 2 月發布全球快速風險評估,性接觸仍是跨國擴散主因,全球傳播風險評估為中,對MSM群體(尤其未固定性伴侶族群)傳播風險為中,對一般民眾傳播風險為低。 全球目前累計報告2例Ib 及IIb 型基因片段之重組病毒株,分別為於英國報告具東南亞旅遊史,以及印度報告具阿拉伯半島國家旅遊史之病患,基因定序顯示其為相同重組病毒株。WHO表示實際病例數可能多於目前通報數,惟重組病毒株臨床症狀與一般分支相,且皆無重症,接觸者追蹤亦未發現續發病例,評估整體風險維持不變。
SydaT1vhYVwa3HYYx6oXHA.en: Monthly update: since 2022 and up to 31 January this year, 144 countries and regions have reported more than 179,000 confirmed cases cumulatively, of which at least 483 died. In January this year, 50 countries and regions reported 1,334 new confirmed cases, including 3 deaths; 66% came from the African Region. Compared with December last year, case numbers rose in the European Region, while other regions declined. Case numbers are declining in all regions globally. Comoros and Réunion reported their first clade Ib cases. In the African Region over the past six weeks (5 January–15 February 2026), 20 countries reported 1,142 confirmed cases, including 4 deaths; the highest numbers were in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Guinea, Madagascar, Liberia and Ghana. Outside Africa, France, Portugal and Spain have continued to report clade Ib community transmission. WHO issued a global rapid risk assessment in February: sexual contact remains the main driver of cross-border spread. The global transmission risk is assessed as moderate; the risk for MSM populations, especially those with non-stable sexual partners, is moderate, and the risk for the general public is low. Globally, two recombinant viruses carrying Ib and IIb gene segments have been reported cumulatively: one in a patient in the United Kingdom with a Southeast Asia travel history, and one in a patient in India with a travel history to Arabian Peninsula countries. Genetic sequencing shows they are the same recombinant strain. WHO notes that actual case numbers may be higher than reported, but the clinical symptoms of the recombinant virus are consistent with ordinary lineages, none have been severe, and contact tracing has found no secondary cases; the overall risk assessment remains unchanged.

ey-aEDjotSBWGWAVyB_WNg.zh: 全球疫情更新,2025年截至12/10共41國/地區累計報告502,264例病例(208,335例確診)及186例死亡,WHO表示季節期間多個區域爆發廣泛疫情,包括先前傳播率較低或無傳播之地區,評估全球傳播風險為中。各區署疫情如下:  美洲區病例為多,該區共16國累計報告291,451例病例(110,039例確診)及141例死亡,以巴西報告243,915例病例及116例死亡為多;  東南亞區累計報告115,985例病例(7,097例確診),主要分布於印度及泰國,其中印度截至8/31累計報告108,379例疑病例及4,995例確診病例; 歐洲區累計56,986例確診病例及43例死亡,其中法國及義大利報告本土病例,另法屬留旺島累計54,555例確診病例及43例死亡,法屬馬約特島累計報告1,259例本土病例; 西太平洋區共11國/地區累計34,035例確診病例及2例死亡,其中中國累計29,497例本土確診病例,主要分布於該國廣東省25,826例; 非洲區累計報告2,211例病例(111例確診),以模里西斯共和國報告1,583例病例為多,葛摩、肯亞、塞內加爾亦報告病例; 東地中海區累計報告1,596例病例(67例確診),其中巴基斯坦及索馬利亞報告病例。
ey-aEDjotSBWGWAVyB_WNg.en: Global outbreak update: in 2025, as of 10 December, 41 countries and areas had reported 502,264 cases cumulatively (208,335 confirmed) and 186 deaths. WHO said widespread outbreaks occurred during the season in several regions, including areas where transmission had previously been low or absent, and assessed the global transmission risk as moderate. Regional situation: the Region of the Americas reported the most cases. Sixteen countries reported 291,451 cases cumulatively (110,039 confirmed) and 141 deaths, mainly Brazil with 243,915 cases and 116 deaths. The South-East Asia Region reported 115,985 cases cumulatively (7,097 confirmed), mainly in India and Thailand; India reported 108,379 suspected and 4,995 confirmed cases as of 31 August. The European Region reported 56,986 confirmed cases and 43 deaths cumulatively. France and Italy reported local cases. Separately, French Réunion reported 54,555 confirmed cases and 43 deaths cumulatively, and French Mayotte reported 1,259 local cases cumulatively. The Western Pacific Region reported 34,035 confirmed cases and 2 deaths cumulatively across 11 countries and areas; China reported 29,497 local confirmed cases, mainly 25,826 in Guangdong province. The African Region reported 2,211 cases cumulatively (111 confirmed), mainly 1,583 cases in the Republic of Mauritius; the Comoros, Kenya and Senegal also reported cases. The Eastern Mediterranean Region reported 1,596 cases cumulatively (67 confirmed), with Pakistan and Somalia reporting cases.

CZ_49AJRgiEeT3xPTFR6Vw.zh: 中國廣東省疫情持續,近1週(9/28-10/4)新增3,181例病例,主要分布於江門市2,480例,其次為佛山市、廣州市及肇慶市分別新增100餘例,無報告重症及死亡病例,江門市近期疫情仍處高點波動,由於假期人潮流動、氣候等因素致疫情傳播風險持續增加,當地已啟動突發公共衛生事件三級響應,全力展開防控工作。 全球疫情持續,今年截至9/30累計40國報告445,271例病例及155例死亡,部分國家/地區於今年發生疫情,包括近幾年病例數並不多之國家/地區。全球病例分布以美洲區最多,其中,以巴西疫情最為嚴峻;歐洲區之法國及義大利報告本土病例,法國今年疫情上升與法屬留旺島及印度洋地區疫情有關,法屬留旺島/馬約特島疫情已下降;東南亞區以印度病例數為多,孟加拉、泰國及斯里蘭卡亦報告病例;西太平洋區之中國廣東省截至9/27累計16,452例確診病例,分布於21城市,以佛山市10,032例及江門市5,209例為多,為該國有紀錄以來最大規模疫情,另廣西壯族自治區於9/1-21報告297例,福建省報告124例,其他省份如湖南省、四川省、海南省亦報告病例;非洲區以模里西斯共和國病例數為多;東地中海區之巴基斯坦及索馬利亞亦報告病例。WHO建議加強監測、實驗室及醫療保健能力、病媒監控,以降低疾病進一步傳播風險。
CZ_49AJRgiEeT3xPTFR6Vw.en: Guangdong Province, China: The outbreak continues. In the past week (28 September–4 October), 3,181 new cases were reported, mainly in Jiangmen city (2,480), followed by Foshan, Guangzhou and Zhaoqing, each with more than 100 new cases. No severe or fatal cases were reported. Jiangmen's outbreak remains at a high level with fluctuations. Because of holiday population movement, weather and other factors, transmission risk continues to increase. The area has launched a Level III public health emergency response and is fully carrying out prevention and control work. Globally, the outbreak continues: as of 30 September this year, 40 countries had reported 445,271 cases and 155 deaths cumulatively. Some countries and regions had outbreaks this year, including some that had reported few cases in recent years. The Americas have the most cases globally, with Brazil the most severe. In Europe, France and Italy reported locally acquired cases. France's rise this year is linked to outbreaks in French Réunion and the Indian Ocean area, while the outbreak in French Réunion and Mayotte has declined. In South-East Asia, India has the most cases, and Bangladesh, Thailand and Sri Lanka also reported cases. In the Western Pacific, Guangdong Province, China, had reported 16,452 confirmed cases as of 27 September, distributed across 21 cities, mainly Foshan (10,032) and Jiangmen (5,209), the largest outbreak on record for the country. Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region reported 297 cases from 1 to 21 September, Fujian Province reported 124, and other provinces such as Hunan, Sichuan and Hainan also reported cases. In Africa, Mauritius has the most cases. In the Eastern Mediterranean, Pakistan and Somalia also reported cases. WHO recommends strengthening surveillance, laboratory and healthcare capacity, and vector control to reduce the risk of further spread.

SMF14DdJoIqMIvRs9-sP5Q.zh: 加拿大亞伯達省通報1例新生兒死亡,為該省今年首例死亡病例,嬰兒母親於懷孕期間感染而早產,於出生後死亡,該名新生兒為今年第7例先天性麻疹病例。該省今年截至10/2累計報告1,914例,其中152例住院及15例重症,多數為未接種疫苗之兒童及青少年,該國今年迄今已報告逾5,000例病例。 法屬留旺島今年7月迄今累計報告4例,目前尚無死亡病例,該島去年疫苗覆蓋率僅80%,遠低於95%,該國衛生部表示由於疫苗覆蓋率不佳,可能有新群聚事件、社區傳播及再度爆發疫情風險。該島於2019年爆發疫情,當年報告96例,自2020年迄今年7月間則無通報病例。
SMF14DdJoIqMIvRs9-sP5Q.en: Alberta, Canada, reported one newborn death, the province's first death this year. The infant's mother was infected during pregnancy, the baby was born prematurely and died after birth, and the newborn was the seventh congenital measles case this year. As of 2 October this year, the province had reported 1,914 cumulative cases, including 152 hospitalizations and 15 severe cases, mostly among unvaccinated children and adolescents. The country has reported more than 5,000 cases so far this year. In French Réunion, 4 cases have been reported cumulatively since July this year, with no deaths so far. Vaccination coverage on the island was only 80% last year, far below 95%. The health ministry says poor vaccination coverage may lead to new clusters, community transmission and renewed outbreaks. The island had an outbreak in 2019, with 96 cases reported that year; no cases were reported from 2020 until July this year.

0mNqZcirHeuyhNniUiZyKA.zh: PAHO於8/26發布警示,美洲地區近年病例數大幅增加,且出現抗藥性菌株,2023年僅4,100餘例病例,去(2024)年大幅增加至4.3萬餘例,今年截至7月報告1.8萬餘例及128例死亡。由於新冠疫情期間不當使用抗生素可能加速抗藥性擴散,且疫苗覆蓋率下降,目前疫苗接種率上升,惟仍低於95%建議水準。PAHO呼籲各國加強實驗室檢測、技術訓練及孕婦與醫護人員接種,並透過標準化監測系統及早偵測與應對。 日本近1週(8/18-8/24)通報2,762例,較前1週1,506例增加1,200餘例,為近3週以來首次上升,以東京都(245例)為多,其次為琦玉縣(182例)。 英國報告今年首例死亡案例,病患為嬰兒,母親未接種疫苗,該嬰兒於今年4-6月間死亡。英蘭今年第二季(4-6月)報告169例確診,較第一季333例為低,亦遠低於去年同期(7,554例)。超過70%病例為15歲以上族群,該地區去年報告11例嬰兒死亡。該國孕婦及嬰幼兒接種率近年皆下降,惟去年報告死亡病例後,孕婦接種率已回升至73%,惟仍低於峰(76%)。 法屬留旺島爆發疫情,今年迄今累計報告70例,高於去年同期17例,約36%病例為5歲以下兒童,並報告重症病例,其中1例死亡,當局呼籲接種疫苗。
0mNqZcirHeuyhNniUiZyKA.en: PAHO issued an alert on 26 August: pertussis cases in the Americas have risen sharply in recent years, and antimicrobial-resistant strains have emerged. There were only about 4,100 cases in 2023; cases rose sharply to over 43,000 last year (2024), and so far this year, as of July, over 18,000 cases and 128 deaths have been reported. Inappropriate antibiotic use during the COVID-19 pandemic may have accelerated the spread of resistance, and vaccination coverage has declined. Vaccination rates have now risen, but remain below the recommended 95%. PAHO calls on countries to strengthen laboratory testing and technical training, to vaccinate pregnant women and health workers, and to detect and respond early through standardized surveillance systems. Japan reported 2,762 cases in the past week (18–24 August), an increase of more than 1,200 from 1,506 the previous week. This is the first rise in three weeks, with Tokyo Metropolis (245 cases) the highest, followed by Saitama Prefecture (182 cases). The United Kingdom reported its first death this year, an infant whose mother was unvaccinated; the infant died between April and June this year. In England, 169 confirmed cases were reported in the second quarter (April–June) this year, lower than the 333 in the first quarter and far below the 7,554 in the same period last year. More than 70% of cases are in the 15-and-over group. The region reported 11 infant deaths last year. Vaccination rates among pregnant women and infants have declined in recent years, but after last year's deaths, the vaccination rate among pregnant women has risen back to 73%, still below the peak of 76%. Réunion (France) has an outbreak: 70 cases have been cumulatively reported this year, 17 more than in the same period last year. About 36% of cases are children under 5, and severe cases have been reported, including one death. Authorities urge vaccination.

TEEthy_-_aneVY0fNVJGuA.zh: 全球今年迄今累計報告約220,000例病例及80例死亡,分布於美/非/亞洲、法屬留旺島及馬約特島,其中,美洲病例數最多,以巴西141,436例及阿根廷2,521例為多,亞洲之印度、斯里蘭卡及巴基斯坦等國報告逾33,000例,非洲塞內加爾亦有報告病例,另法屬留旺島/馬約特島分別報告逾51,000例及560例,ECDC評估歐洲目前環境愈來愈利於病媒蚊活動,當地疾病傳播風險增加。
TEEthy_-_aneVY0fNVJGuA.en: Globally this year, about 220,000 cases and 80 deaths have been reported cumulatively, in the Americas, Africa and Asia, as well as in the French overseas territories of Réunion and Mayotte. The Americas have the most cases, with Brazil reporting 141,436 and Argentina 2,521. Asian countries including India, Sri Lanka and Pakistan have reported more than 33,000 cases. Senegal in Africa has also reported cases. Réunion and Mayotte have reported more than 51,000 and 560 cases, respectively. ECDC assesses that the environment in Europe is increasingly favorable for vector mosquito activity, and the risk of local transmission is increasing.

BlEvoEhqmd5zISnFQYwxfQ.zh: 法屬留旺島疫情更新,今年疫情於第13週逾7,500例病例達高峰後,自第18週病例數降至低於2,000例,今年迄今累計約52,000例病例及15例死亡,死亡及重症病例均以65歲以上罹患合併症個案為多,另累計71例重症病例中, 3個月以下嬰兒占23例。
BlEvoEhqmd5zISnFQYwxfQ.en: Update on the outbreak in Réunion (France): this year's cases peaked at more than 7,500 in week 13, and after week 18 weekly cases fell to below 2,000. So far this year, about 52,000 cases and 15 deaths have been reported cumulatively. Most deaths and severe cases occurred among people aged 65 and over with comorbidities. Of the 71 severe cases reported cumulatively, 23 were infants under 3 months old.

AR5On3__qc_WYl8Rg16D2w.zh: 法國疫情更新,於5/1-20報告225例病例,約為去年全年病例數的10倍,今年迄今累計報告950餘例病例,明顯高於前2年病例數,病例主要來自法屬留旺島。因主要病媒蚊於該國之活躍期為5-11月,預期疫情將持續上升。
AR5On3__qc_WYl8Rg16D2w.en: France update: 225 cases were reported between 1 and 20 May, about 10 times the total for all of last year. So far this year, more than 950 cases have been reported cumulatively, significantly higher than in the previous two years. The cases mainly come from Réunion. Because the main vector mosquitoes are active in France from May to November, cases are expected to keep rising.

ZTW5uRHzYq7nGAxZZ0uYzQ.zh: 法屬馬約特島疫情上升,自3/5於該島東北部發現首例輸入病例後,截至5/4累計報告116例病例,其中57例為本土病例,1例住院治療,迄無死亡病例,為自2005-06年疫情以來首次報告本土傳播病例,另法屬留旺島近期亦爆發大規模疫情,WHO預期印度洋島嶼將進一步爆發疫情。
ZTW5uRHzYq7nGAxZZ0uYzQ.en: Mayotte (France): the outbreak is rising. After the first imported case was detected in the northeast of the island on 5 March, 116 cases had been reported cumulatively as of 4 May, of which 57 were locally acquired, and 1 patient is hospitalized. No deaths have been recorded. This is the first reported locally acquired case since the outbreak of 2005–06. Meanwhile, Réunion (France) has recently experienced a large outbreak, and WHO expects further outbreaks on Indian Ocean islands.

QNFv1AgTxdigqubZ7LLs8A.zh: 法屬留旺島疫情持續,近1週(4/28-5/4)報告3,079例病例,今年迄今累計逾47,500例病例及12例死亡,死亡病例均為70歲以上且患有合併症個案。另該島病例增加導致法國本土傳播風險增加,自今年以來,法國已發現766例輸入性病例,近97%(742例)來自留旺島。
QNFv1AgTxdigqubZ7LLs8A.en: Réunion update: the outbreak continues. In the most recent week (28 April–4 May), 3,079 cases were reported, and so far this year more than 47,500 cases and 12 deaths have been reported cumulatively. All deaths were in people aged over 70 with comorbidities. Because case numbers on the island are rising, the risk of local transmission in mainland France has increased. Since the beginning of the year, France has detected 766 imported cases, of which nearly 97% (742 cases) came from Réunion.

dTfDquY-q-JMUcFG81OWbQ.zh: 法屬留旺島疫情更新,近1週報告4,304例本土病例,今年迄今累計39,532例病例,自第11週迄今已報告47例重症,重症個案主要為老年族群及嬰兒。 法屬馬約特島疫情更新,今年迄今累計報告55例病例,其中17例為本土病例,1例住院治療,迄無死亡病例,該國鄰近之法屬留旺島近期疫情亦為嚴峻。
dTfDquY-q-JMUcFG81OWbQ.en: Réunion update: the outbreak is ongoing. In the most recent week, 4,304 locally acquired cases were reported, and so far this year 39,532 cases have been reported cumulatively. Since week 11, 47 severe cases have been reported, mainly among older people and infants. Mayotte update: 55 cases have been reported cumulatively this year, of which 17 were locally acquired; 1 patient is hospitalized and there have been no deaths so far. The recent outbreak on neighboring Réunion is also severe.

WBvuna4xQ0bkW8a3mcIinA.zh: 全球今年截至3月累計14國/地區報告約80,000例病例及46例死亡,分布於美/非/亞洲、法屬留旺島及馬約特島,其中,美洲病例數最多,以巴西71,578例(44例死亡)及阿根廷1,550例為多,亞洲巴基斯坦報告393例,非洲塞內加爾報告2例,另法屬留旺島報告逾13,000例(2例死亡),法屬馬約特島報告1例,ECDC評估歐洲目前環境仍不利於病媒蚊活動,每年疫情多發生於6 -11月。
WBvuna4xQ0bkW8a3mcIinA.en: As of March this year, 14 countries and regions globally have reported about 80,000 cases and 46 deaths cumulatively, distributed across the Americas, Africa and Asia, as well as Réunion and Mayotte (France). The Americas have the most cases, led by Brazil with 71,578 cases (44 deaths) and Argentina with 1,550. In Asia, Pakistan reported 393 cases; in Africa, Senegal reported 2 cases. Réunion (France) reported more than 13,000 cases (2 deaths), and Mayotte (France) reported 1 case. The ECDC assesses that the environment in Europe is still unfavourable for vector mosquito activity, and outbreaks in Europe each year mostly occur from June to November.

X1MV4q_w6_G24OPwV6VRMg.zh: 法屬留旺島疫情持續,近1週(3/17-23)報告5,800餘例確診病例,迄今累計20,200餘例病例及2例死亡,以勒唐蓬4,700例病例為多。 模里西斯共和國報告1例本土病例,為37歲女性,3/15檢驗陽性,為該國自2009年以來首例病例,由於鄰近之法屬留旺島適逢疫情流行,該國已加強疫情監測及因應防治措施。
X1MV4q_w6_G24OPwV6VRMg.en: The outbreak on French Réunion continues. In the past week (17–23 March), over 5,800 confirmed cases were reported, bringing the cumulative total to over 20,200 cases and 2 deaths; Le Tampon accounts for most of these, with 4,700 cases. The Republic of Mauritius has reported one local case, a 37-year-old woman who tested positive on 15 March. This is the country's first case since 2009. Because the neighbouring French Réunion is experiencing an epidemic, Mauritius has strengthened surveillance and response measures.

fAAlsbn0jY1NlCkyniZQ7Q.zh: 全球今年截至2/25累計14國報告逾30,000例病例及14例死亡,分布於美洲(11國)、非洲(1國)、亞洲(1國)及歐洲(1國),美洲病例數最多,以巴西31,484例(14例死亡)及阿根廷512例為多,亞洲之巴基斯坦報告201例,非洲之塞內加爾報告2例,另法屬留旺島報告1,631例。
fAAlsbn0jY1NlCkyniZQ7Q.en: As of 25 February this year, 14 countries globally have reported over 30,000 cases and 14 deaths cumulatively, distributed across the Americas (11 countries), Africa (1 country), Asia (1 country) and Europe (1 country). The Americas have the most cases, mainly Brazil with 31,484 cases (14 deaths) and Argentina with 512. Pakistan in Asia reported 201 cases, Senegal in Africa reported 2 cases, and French Réunion reported 1,631 cases.

1D3cYUAwtxX0PDQWtuznuA.zh: 法屬留旺島疫情持續,今年迄今累計927例病例,自2024年8月迄今累計1,069例本土病例,主要分布於勒唐蓬及萊唐薩萊,由於夏季及近期的降雨有利於疾病傳播,預測當地疫情可能持續並擴散至整個島嶼。
1D3cYUAwtxX0PDQWtuznuA.en: The outbreak on French Réunion continues. So far this year, 927 cases have been reported cumulatively. Since August 2024, 1,069 locally acquired cases have been reported cumulatively, mainly in Le Tampon and L'Étang-Salé. Because summer and recent rainfall favour transmission, the outbreak is expected to continue and may spread across the whole island.

N7gerXuI-3sE0P82Qs4mOA.zh: 法屬留旺島疫情明顯上升,於2025年第4週新增31例病例,自2024年8月迄今累計529例本土病例,以勒唐蓬、聖皮耶及萊唐薩萊之疫情較為嚴峻。 菲律賓疫情更新,達沃市2024年累計12例病例,當局已加強宣導以免疫情擴大。
N7gerXuI-3sE0P82Qs4mOA.en: The outbreak on French Réunion has risen markedly, with 31 new cases in week 4 of 2025. Since August 2024, 529 local cases have been reported cumulatively, with the outbreaks most severe in Le Tampon, Saint-Pierre and L'Étang-Salé. Philippines update: Davao City reported 12 cases cumulatively in 2024. Authorities have strengthened awareness campaigns to prevent the outbreak from spreading.

kKjDD8D3jfeltXBd-IjQjQ.zh: 法屬留旺島疫情上升,該地區自去年8/23迄今累計報告192例病例,病例主要分布於萊唐薩萊,當局採已取防治措施,以控制疫情。 巴西疫情持續,今年截至1/17累計報告523例病例,去年累計420,000餘例病例及200餘例死亡,病例主要分布於伯南布科、聖保羅及帕拉伊巴州。
kKjDD8D3jfeltXBd-IjQjQ.en: Chikungunya cases are rising in Réunion, a French overseas territory. Since 23 August last year, 192 cases have been reported cumulatively, mainly in L'Étang-Salé, and authorities have taken prevention and control measures to contain the outbreak. Brazil's outbreak continues: so far this year (to 17 January), 523 cases have been reported cumulatively. Last year Brazil reported over 420,000 cases and over 200 deaths, mainly in Pernambuco, São Paulo and Paraíba states.
